description: Apply a batch of Core pixel/layer/region operations to an editable .mcpx source in one call (atomic by default: the first failure rolls everything back). This is the batch-edit slot; never split pixel work across hundreds of per-pixel tool calls.

atomic.description: Default true: the first failure rolls the canvas back and the whole batch fails.

feedback.description: Optional visual feedback for the batch; absent keeps the output fields and bytes exactly as before.

crop.description: Feedback selection expression (atom string or JSON expression object); refused with image none, ignored with image changed.

diff.description: Feedback diff: none (default) or summary with raw, composited, structural, and outsideSelectionUnchanged.

image.description: Feedback image: none (default, flags only), full (whole crop), or changed (composited change bounds; the crop is ignored). Changed with no visible difference returns noVisibleChange instead of an image.

scale.description: Feedback integer upscale factor 1-16 with nearest sampling; omitted auto-scales from the pre-scale long edge below 128.

operations.description: Batch operations applied in order in a single call; never split pixel work across hundreds of tool calls.

items.description: Batch operation object with a `type` (setPixel, drawLine, fillRect, floodFill, createLayer, setRegionPixel, and the rest of the Core batch vocabulary) plus its per-type arguments.

outputMcpxPath.description: Explicit .mcpx output path. When omitted, the .mcpx text is embedded in the result instead of written to disk.

outputPngPath.description: Explicit PNG output path. When omitted, the PNG bytes are embedded in the result instead of written to disk.

sourcePath.description: Editable .mcpx source path the batch runs against.

name: apply_asset_operations
